turns.text: I reported a scrape on the print, and your reply said it was part of the artwork. It's a raised scratch across the ink. I'd like to dispute that decision.

I’m sorry your report was dismissed. I’ve passed your dispute to a colleague, who will take over and review the decision. Please share your order number and the email you used to place the order so they can find your original report.

input.summary: Customer disputes the decision on a previously reported scrape: the prior reply said it was part of the artwork, but the customer describes a raised scratch across the ink. Please review the prior damage decision. No order number or email provided yet.
